tool.name: Evo 2 API
tool.description: DNA generation and analysis via NVIDIA NIM (40B parameter model)

param.name: sequence
param.label: Input DNA sequence
param.help: DNA sequence using A, T, C, G characters

param.name: api_key
param.label: NVIDIA API Key
param.help: Get from build.nvidia.com. Leave empty to use NVIDIA_API_KEY env variable.

tool.help:
**Evo 2: DNA Foundation Model**
40 billion parameter model trained on 9 trillion DNA tokens.
**Capabilities:** - Generate DNA sequence continuations - Score mutation effects - Analyze sequence patterns
**API Key:** Get your key at https://build.nvidia.com/arcinstitute/evo-2-40b
**Citation:** Arc Institute (2025). Evo 2: A 40 billion parameter DNA foundation model.
